theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Leader with the strongest score and confirming trend health; the absolute-trend-gate leg supports staying with the leader, while crowding is a size-down caution only, not a fade.
evidence: crowding_z 2.13, crowded true — crowding-skeptic read as size-down caution; guardrails forbid fading the leader
theses.dissent: Crowding-skeptic: CIBR crowding_z 2.13 and maximum breadth often mark late-stage extension; one_narrative false means no self-reinforcing one-way market; thematic-ETF inflows and attention spikes have historically marked local tops, so adding after the run is the documented failure mode.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Non-crowded broad leadership with high durability relative to rank, supported by the trend-gate leg; crowding is absent and breadth is full.
evidence: hurst_tag mixed — absolute-trend gate is primary risk control, not a return forecast
theses.dissent: Crowding-skeptic: mixed hurst means no clean trend-gate confirmation; silver miners carry metal-price, real-rate, and USD beta; rank 4 score is not leadership and the rotation margin to the leader is large.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Trend-clean, broad, non-crowded miners theme; durability and breadth support trend-gated exposure despite a lower momentum score.
evidence: absolute_trend_gate validated_risk_control leg supports staying power
theses.dissent: Crowding-skeptic: rank 7 is not leadership and the momentum rank is display-only with no validated return edge; crowded false does not create an edge by itself, and gold miners can reverse quickly on real-rate and macro shifts.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
